translations.web: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
translations.bsb: And the gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and their associates, who kept watch at the gates—172 men.
